'''''Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown''''' is the tenth in a [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest|series]] of young reader novels that chronicle the adventures of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] between [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].

This book features a journey to Korriban to stop [[Granta Omega]], an enemy of the Jedi, along with [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], an evil scientist, from meeting a dangerous [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The Jedi meet many perils, including ancient visions, an entire army, and the dangers of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]]. ''The Final Showdown'', written by [[Jude Watson]] brings one, debatable outcome:

Is an uneasily obtained success worth a loss that could have been avoided?
